page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of "ECONOMICA" is ornate; the first letter is read as E, but it may be a ligature or the Œ of the title, so it is marked [?]. The German passage at the foot is black letter and is transcribed as printed, including the mixed u/v and the macron on "erworbē". The long s is set as plain s throughout, per the rules, though the scan shows an f-like form. The reading "hîc" is taken from the italic type and may carry a mark over the i.
